source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As the Fight phase begins, every enemy unit in Engagement Range of at least one of your units with this ability takes a Battle-shock test, taking 1 off the result for a unit that is Below Half-strength.

effect.battleShockTest: each enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units with this ability
